create.name: Master Faye Li Yip
create.bio:
Master Faye Li Yip (Li Hui) was born in China into a family of martial artists and is the daughter of the Taiji teacher Professor Li Deyin. She began Shaolin training at seven, went on to Xing Yi, Bagua and Taiji under her father, and learned from her grand-uncle Li Tianji, the Xing Yi and Bagua master Sha Guozheng and Grandmaster Sun Jianyun, which gives her a direct line to Sun style Tai Chi. Her grandfather taught her Qigong. She competed in national competitions in China before moving to the UK, and has more than forty years of training behind her.

With her husband, Master Tary Yip, she founded the Deyin Taijiquan Institute in Telford and the British Health Qigong Association. She teaches Yang and Sun style Tai Chi, the Tai Chi Kung Fu Fan created by her father, Tai Chi sword and the Health Qigong sets such as Ba Duan Jin and Yi Jin Jing, through weekly classes on Zoom, seminars across the UK and Europe, a summer retreat, instructor training and cultural trips to China. Her family's YouTube channel carries many of her form demonstrations, and she also teaches self-paced Qigong courses on The Shift Network. She has led performances at public events in the UK, including the countdown to the 2012 London Olympics.

courses.title: Weekly Classes with Masters Tary & Faye 2026-27
courses.description: A year of live weekly classes on Zoom, with recordings kept for three months for practice. On Wednesdays Master Faye teaches the Yang style 16-step Tai Chi sword and the 12 methods of Daoyin Yang Sheng Gong with meditation; on Thursdays Master Tary teaches Sun style Tai Chi. Students can join one class or the full programme.
courses.price: £240 GBP (one class, full year, non-member); £540 GBP (all classes, non-member)

courses.title: Tai Chi & Qigong Summer Retreat 2027
courses.description: A four-day residential gathering at Lilleshall National Sports Centre in Shropshire, run by the Deyin Taijiquan Institute and the British Health Qigong Association. The programme mixes Tai Chi forms, Health Qigong, push hands, meditation and Chinese cultural arts for all levels.
courses.price: From £550 GBP (residential, twin sharing, non-member); £450 GBP non-residential

courses.title: Tibet Cultural and Tai Chi Exchange China Trip 2027
courses.description: An 18-day group journey from Beijing by the Qinghai-Tibet railway to Lhasa, Nyingchi and Chengdu. Tai Chi and Health Qigong are practised daily in parks and sacred sites, with exchanges with local practitioners and visits to temples and landmarks.
courses.price: £2295 GBP early booking (before 31 Dec 2026); £2395 GBP standard; twin sharing, flights not included

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @DeyinTaiChiQigong 21.2K subscribers (channel page, 31 Oct 2026; the Deyin Taijiquan Institute channel she shares with her husband); Facebook DeyinTaiChiInstitute and X @deyintaichi counts not readable without login → ~21k → local_hero
flags: Her YouTube, Facebook and X accounts belong to the Deyin Taijiquan Institute, which she runs with her husband Master Tary Yip; the videos chosen are ones whose titles or descriptions name her as the performer.
Couple: Master Tary Yip co-founded the institute and co-teaches the weekly classes, retreat and trips; he is not in the sprint, so she stands as the one listing.

The email info@deyinevents.com belongs to Deyin Event Management, her and Tary's events company (shown in the footer of deyinevents.com); the institute's contact form also pre-fills contact-us@deyin-taiji.com.
Only one photo confirmed (Shift Network headshot, 300 px); the YouTube avatar is the institute logo.

All four of her Shift Network courses were left out under the health-claim rule (sales pages list conditions such as arthritis, insomnia, back pain, sciatica, anxiety); her two other Shift programmes are behind a 'Load more' button and couldn't be read.
The Tibet trip and summer retreat are institute events; the pages say they are led by the Deyin masters but don't name her on every page.
